paragraphs.text: Canals cross hills by using locks, which raise or lower boats from one water level to another. A lock is a rectangular chamber with gates at each end.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: To raise a boat, it enters the empty chamber through the lower gates, which are then closed behind it. Water is let in from the upper canal through small openings called paddles, and the boat rises as the chamber fills.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: When the water inside reaches the level of the upper canal, the upper gates can be opened, and the boat continues its journey. To lower a boat, the process is reversed, with water released into the lower canal.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Most lock gates are made of oak and are opened by pushing against a long wooden arm called a balance beam.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Some canals have long flights of locks, one after another, which allow boats to climb steep hills gently in a series of small steps.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: it enters the empty chamber through the lower gates

explanation.en: “through the lower gates” → gates, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: «through the lower gates» → gates, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: «through the lower gates» → gates, во множественном числе, как в тексте.

explanation.en: Water comes in from the upper canal “through small openings called paddles” — the arrow on the right. Answer: paddles, plural.
explanation.kk: Су жоғарғы каналдан «through small openings called paddles» кіреді — сызбаның оң жағындағы нұсқар. Жауап paddles, көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: Вода поступает из верхнего канала «through small openings called paddles» — стрелка на схеме справа. Ответ paddles, во множественном числе.

items.quote: A lock is a rectangular chamber with gates at each end

explanation.en: The middle of the diagram is “a rectangular chamber with gates at each end”, where the boat waits. Answer: chamber.
explanation.kk: Сызбаның ортасы — «a rectangular chamber with gates at each end», қайық сонда тұрады. Жауап chamber.
explanation.ru: Центральная часть схемы — «a rectangular chamber with gates at each end», где стоит лодка. Ответ chamber.

items.quote: a long wooden arm called a balance beam

explanation.en: “a long wooden arm called a balance beam” → balance. “Beam” is on the diagram, and “oak” is what gates are made of.
explanation.kk: «a long wooden arm called a balance beam» → balance. «Beam» сызбада тұр, ал «oak» — қақпаның материалы.
explanation.ru: «a long wooden arm called a balance beam» → balance. «Beam» уже на схеме, а «oak» — материал ворот.

items.quote: When the water inside reaches the level of the upper canal

explanation.en: “the level of the upper canal” → canal. On the right of the diagram is the upper canal.
explanation.kk: «the level of the upper canal» → canal. Сызбаның оң жағында — жоғарғы каналдың суы.
explanation.ru: «the level of the upper canal» → canal. На схеме справа — вода верхнего канала.
